s-1.ptxt: Inspect and Adjust Joint Angle (Drive Type 4WD)

s2.ptxt: Before measuring the angle, settle each part using the following procedure.

s3.ptxt: Rotate the propeller shaft several times by hand.
Place a jack under the differential and move it up and down.

atten3.ptxt: Perform the measurement in a condition as close to the vehicle being on the ground as possible, using a 4-post lift, pit or equivalent.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, measure the installation angle of the intermediate shaft assembly (A in the illustration).
Using SST, measure the installation angle between the intermediate shaft assembly (A in the illustration) and propeller shaft assembly (B in the illustration).
Using SST, measure the installation angle between the propeller shaft assembly (B in the illustration) and differential (C in the illustration).
If the result is not as specified, replace the adjusting washers at the center support bearing with appropriate ones.

item.ptxt: Use washers of the same thickness on the left and right.

s2.ptxt: Gasket Installation

s3.ptxt: Insert a new gasket into the exhaust center pipe assembly as far as it will go by hand.

item.ptxt: Do not install the gasket in the wrong direction.
Do not reuse a gasket once it has been removed.
Do not damage the gasket by dropping it, etc.
Do not damage the gasket sliding surface.
Never push the gasket in by installing the exhaust pipe without first pressing it in sufficiently by hand.

s3.ptxt: Install a new gasket to the exhaust pipe assembly front.
